data.description: Sticky, arm-length tendrils cover a mu spore.  A mu spore can use these tendrils to attempt a grab as an immediate action when an adjacent creature hits it with a melee attack.  As it is only using the tendrils (instead of conducting the grapple normally), it takes a -20 penalty to its CMB to make and maintain the grapple (+31 CMB with tendrils).  The mu spore does not gain the grappled condition while grappling a creature with its tendrils.
